Find $\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}$ for the ellipse shown above." :question/worked-solution "Since our ellipse is centered at the origin and has semiaxes $1$ and $3,$ its equation is given by

$$
\frac{{x}^{2}}{{1}^{2}}+\frac{{y}^{2}}{{3}^{2}}=1\,⟹\,{x}^{2}+\frac{{y}^{2}}{9}=1.
$$

Now, to calculate $\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x},$ we use implicit differentiation:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}({x}^{2}+\frac{{y}^{2}}{9}) & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(1) \\ \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}({x}^{2})+\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\frac{{y}^{2}}{9}) & =0 \\ 2x+\frac{2y}{9}\cdot \frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =0 \\ \frac{2y}{9}\cdot \frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =-2x \\ \frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =-\frac{9x}{y}\end{aligned}
$$" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy :question/answer-fields ["cc377f79-c91d-5163-84d3-cf26a1ed63ab"] :db/ensure :question/validate} {:db/id "generator" :question-generator/id #uuid "23e3dea6-0070-5c2d-9841-01d73c2e86aa" :question-generator/script "generate/scratch/17592186166866.py"} [:db/add 17592186166866 :knowledge-point/question-generator "generator"] {:db/id 17592186166866 :knowledge-point/questions ["d7a2ead7-a103-561d-ae19-16273e0e5510"]} [:db/ensure 17592186166866 :knowledge-point/validate]]
